mods.name: The Twilight Forest:Re26
mods.description: Unofficial port of Twilight Forest from Minecraft 1.21.1 to Minecraft 26.1.x and 26.2.x, adapting the mod's dimension, biomes, structures, bosses, items, and mechanics to the latest Minecraft version for modern gameplay.

releases.notes:
## Changes in 4.8.4210
- Fixed the client protocol error crash caused by Reactor Debris writing negative sizes after a second save (min > max in Shapes.box)
- Existing saves with corrupted debris bounds are normalised and clamped on load

## Changes in 4.8.4209-hotfix
- Fixed the client crash when the Aurora sky effect first renders (26.3's UBO storage API was used incorrectly)
- Added the C2ME density-function compiler bindings and a reliable OpenCL incompatibility fallback for the Twilight Forest dimension

## Prerequisite (Important)
This mod requires Forge Config API Port to run properly:
- CurseForge: `https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forge-config-api-port`
- Modrinth: `https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port`

Requires Fabric Loader `0.20.0+` and Fabric API `0.163.0+26.3`.

## Minecraft 26.3
First Fabric build for the **Minecraft 26.3 release**. The 26.3 API restructure touched almost every subsystem, so the whole mod was re-adapted:
- **World generation**: biome-driven terrain and surface rules moved to the material rule system, new noise settings layout, density functions rebuilt on the sampler API
- **Structures**: piece generation on the new structure piece builder, jigsaw placement, structure bounding boxes and controlled spawns
- **Loot tables**: rolls and count providers on the split int/float number providers, including the multiplayer boss-fight roll adjusters
- **Trees and features**: tree configurations, huge mushrooms and canopy features
- **Rendering**: 26.3 render pipeline API (sky, aurora, chests, signs, trophies, force fields, magic paintings)

## Fixes
- Fixed structures not carving terrain: the beardifier marker was missing from the final density function, so hollow hills, the hydra lair, labyrinths, courtyards and yeti caves had no terrain shaping
- Fixed the sun and moon not being hidden in the Twilight Forest dimension
- Fixed the dev client dying at startup on Windows (JVM stack shadow pages)
- Fixed portal teleport blocking the server thread on chunk generation
- Synced C2ME parallel worldgen hardening from the 26.2 branch: the overworld seed is cached behind a volatile field so parallel worldgen executors never touch the server object, and chunk blanket processors guard their biome sampling
- Synced the Fabric multipart entity chunk crash fix: multipart parts no longer tick while their chunk is unloaded

## Hydra
- Synced the Hydra's attack logic with upstream: bite/flame/mortar chances and ranges, secondary target attacks, look and body turn speeds, shield interaction and reflected-mortar damage range
- Fixed the heads and necks staying locked in a collapsed pose (clampedLerp factor order)
- Fixed the Hydra being culled while its visible body parts were still on screen

## C2ME / OpenCL
- Added a pre-launch compatibility hook for C2ME's OpenCL acceleration module: the Twilight Forest dimension falls back to CPU generation instead of crashing the server, while the vanilla dimensions keep OpenCL acceleration

## Changes in 4.8.4209
- Hydra combat logic fully synced with upstream (attack chances and ranges, secondary attacks, body/head turning, shield interaction, reflected-mortar damage range) and the collapsed head/neck pose fixed
- C2ME-OCL compatibility: the Twilight Forest dimension falls back to CPU generation instead of crashing the server when C2ME's OpenCL accelerator is installed

releases.notes:
## Changes in 4.8.4210
- Added the C2ME density-function compiler bindings for Twilight Forest's custom density functions
- Added a reliable C2ME OpenCL fallback (in-memory flag + c2me.toml) so the Twilight Forest dimension generates on the CPU instead of crashing

## Prerequisite (Important)
This mod requires Forge Config API Port to run properly (not bundled in this jar):
- CurseForge: `https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forge-config-api-port`
- Modrinth: `https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port`

Requires Fabric Loader `0.19.3+`, Fabric API `0.158.0+26.2` and Forge Config API Port `26.1.3+`.

## Minecraft 26.2
Fabric build for Minecraft 26.2. This is the first Fabric release since 26.1.2, so it rolls up the whole 26.2 port plus the fixes below.

## C2ME & server
- Hardened world generation for C2ME's parallel generation: the overworld seed is resolved lazily behind a volatile field registered at `SERVER_STARTING`, so worldgen workers never touch the server object, and chunk blanket processors guard their biome sampling
- Guarded the mushroom block `canSurvive` mixin against `WorldGenRegion` chunk bounds to avoid a C2ME crash
- Fixed multipart entities ticking while their chunk is unloaded (Fabric chunk crash)
- Fixed portal teleport blocking the server thread during chunk generation

## Bosses & combat
- Fixed the Lich fight: phase 3 attacks, minion summoning, lifedrain trigger and weapon switching
- Fixed Naga body segments not following the head during a charge, and adjusted Naga Courtyard terrain generation
- Fixed the Destruction enchantment not smashing blocks
- Fixed the Fortification Scepter not consuming durability per use

## Items & equipment
- Travel goggles: item display GUI stays readable with the F3 debug overlay open, removed the default `ITEM_DISPLAY` component and fixed the swap logic
- Phantom armor is kept on death in all game modes
- Corrected vanilla mining tier tags (`needs_*`/`incorrect_for_*`) so vanilla blocks such as ancient debris keep vanilla behaviour
- Fixed the sulfur cube growing when it picks up giant blocks by itself

## Rendering
- Fixed dimension rendering of stars, clouds and precipitation
- Sun and moon are hidden in the Twilight Forest dimension
- Fixed sign rendering for 26.2 (block model based signs, GUI background textures, wall sign variants)
- Reduced IceLayer rendering jitter and freeze overlay jitter in the Frosted effect

## World generation & data
- Added chunk generator tuning for the Twilight Forest noise settings
- Removed residual dark tree leaves inside the Dark Tower between Y11-Y22
- Fixed worldgen JSON block ids (`twilightforest:root` -> `twilightforest:root_block`)
- Added hollow log translations across all languages and corrected advancements

## Hydra
- Synced the Hydra's attack logic with upstream: bite/flame/mortar chances and ranges, secondary target attacks, look and body turn speeds, shield interaction and reflected-mortar damage range
- Fixed the heads and necks staying locked in a collapsed pose (clampedLerp factor order)
- Fixed the Hydra being culled while its visible body parts were still on screen

## C2ME / OpenCL
- Added a pre-launch compatibility hook for C2ME's OpenCL acceleration module: the Twilight Forest dimension now falls back to CPU generation instead of crashing the server, while the vanilla dimensions keep OpenCL acceleration

## Changes in 4.8.4209
- Hydra combat logic fully synced with upstream (attack chances and ranges, secondary attacks, body/head turning, shield interaction, reflected-mortar damage range) and the collapsed head/neck pose fixed
- C2ME-OCL compatibility: the Twilight Forest dimension falls back to CPU generation instead of crashing the server when C2ME's OpenCL accelerator is installed

- Fixed the Hydra's head attacks and breath attacks failing to work
- Fixed all boss health bars showing as white: each boss now has its own matching health bar color

- Fixed the Uncrafting Table crashing with an error when used

## World Generation Fixes
- Fixed terrain sinking and clipping around large structures (courtyards, strongholds, etc.)
- Fixed some biomes failing to generate properly
- Fixed abnormal generation of structures such as the Lich Tower and Dark Tower

## Visuals & Details
- Fixed multiple block models showing as pink missing-texture blocks (Mushgloom, Torchberry Plant, Trollber, etc.)
- Added 9 trophy item models (Naga, Lich, Hydra, Snow Queen, etc.)
- Fixed the Twilight Forest dimension lighting being abnormally too dark

## Other
- Fixed config files failing to load properly (this fix is unverified)
- Removed unused code for better stability
